notes.title: Version 0.9.07 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Game Update Announcement

Balance Adjustments

 Added 2 tweezers available for purchase in the shop.
 Soul Shifting, Celestial Navigation, and Spirit Possession can now be used while moving.


Visual Enhancements

 Added attenuation range to door opening/closing during meetings.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed issue with male clapping sound being absent.
 Fixed issue where clapping at night could be heard by nearby players.
 Addressed crashes caused by certain LUA scripts in specific scenarios.
 Resolved problem where living players could write on the Ouija board.
 Fixed issue with bindings being removable in the Crimson Dream.

notes.title: Version 0.9.06 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Version 0.9.06 Patch Notes

Balance Changes:
During meetings, birdcages are now hidden to prevent obstructing the vision of the Seer.
Strange Tales of Liao Zhai: When equipped, the speed of Sanity reduction during Ghost Possession is reduced by 20%.
After a birdcage is stolen, ownership of all placed birdcages will be exchanged, and no more than 9 birdcages will appear on the field.

Art Improvements:
Optimized close-range kill animation.
Enhanced execution animation.
Fixed occasional issue with the monk having hair.

Bug Fixes:
Rectified misalignment of tutorial images.
Fixed a bug where certain situations would cause Zhong Kui to get stuck.
Addressed a bug where after reconnecting, players could hear conversations of others during the night.

notes.title: V0.9.05 Update
V 0.9.03 Game Update Announcement
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840888/fae2dbd205b908ab21476d66100424cf79c4189c.jpg

Game Update Announcement

Enhancements
To better deceive others, all abilities of Possessors now have unified sound effects and visual effects, and the timing for the use of Deceptive Blade and Chain of Doom is now more flexible.

Balance Changes

 When using ShapeShifter 's skill, smoke will now be generated.
 All Possessors' abilities (ShapeShifter/Backtrace/Crow) now generate smoke upon use and produce distance sound effects.
 Modification to Deceptive Blade: When killing non-offline teammates, the opponent must crouch to allow the kill.
 Modification to Chain of Doom: The restriction of purchasing only when there is 1 Possessor has been removed; it can be purchased in advance, but the effect will only activate when there is only 1 Possessor left on the field after killing the target.
 Two bookshelves in the Embroidery Building are now searchable, and an air wall has been added at the carriage location.
 Room entry levels changed from 0/3/8 to 0/3/6.


Artistic Improvements

 Optimized character outlines in the game.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed the issue where purchased backpack items for Possessors were not effective.
 Fixed the problem where players would still be affected by low sanity voice effects on the game settlement interface.
 Optimized game rendering efficiency.
